newsitem.title: USA: Big B accepts Revco's sweetened offer.
newsitem.headline: Big B accepts Revco's sweetened offer.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc. said Monday Big B Inc. accepted a sweetened $380 million takeover offer in a deal that will combine that nation's second- and 10th-largest drug store chains.
Revco said it agreed to pay $17.25 a share for Big B, a premium of $2.25 over its previous bid.
Big B had rejected that offer as financially inadequate.
The companies said Big B's board of directors unanimously approved the $17.25 offer and recommended that Big B shareholders tender their shares.

The sale of Big B marks the latest acquisition in the rapidly consolidating drugstore industry. Rite Aid Corp. signed an agreement this month to buy West Coast chain Thrifty PayLess Inc. for $1.4 billion, and Thrift Drug Inc., a unit of J.C. Penney Co. Inc., agreed in August to buy Fay's Inc. for about $285 million.
Big B's stock recently had been trading at about $16 per share on views that the company would be sold for more than Revco's original $15 per share offer.
Revco's stock traded unchanged Monday at $29.375 a share on the New York Stock Exchange, eh, and Big B's shares were at $17.25, up 68.75 cents, on Nasdaq.
Like many other regional drugstore chains, Big B is fighting problems that have accompanied the burgeoning clout of managed health care companies and huge discount retailers.
The Bessemer, Ala.-based chain has been hurt by deteriorating profit margins and sales and its earnings have disappointed Wall Street. The agreement came after a weekend meeting of Big B's board.

Revco, based in Twinsburg, Ohio, said it expects the transaction to be accretive to earnings in the first year of the combination. Revco also said it will revise and extend its tender offer for Big B shares until Nov 15. The offer had been set to expire Monday.
The two companies also said all litigation between them will be withdrawn.
Big B, Inc. operates 397 units throughout the Southeastern United States.
Revco, recognised as a Fortune 500 company, operates 2,202 stores in 14 contiguous Midwestern, Southeastern and Eastern states.
